summary.zh-CN: 上传资料即可开始：研究简报、多源对比、知识库条目与术语表，每条结论标来源与检索日期，事实与推断分开；写入知识库需你确认。
summary.en: Start from uploaded materials: research briefs, multi-source comparison, knowledge base articles and glossaries. Every conclusion carries its source and retrieval date, facts stay apart from inferences, and writing to a knowledge base needs your confirmation.

now.zh-CN: 从多份资料提炼可追溯研究简报，事实、推断与待核实项分开，每条标来源与检索日期
now.en: Turn multiple materials into a traceable brief; facts, inferences and open items are separated, each with source and retrieval date

now.zh-CN: 把两个以上来源按统一维度逐格对比，列出一致、分歧与缺失项，不替你裁定谁对
now.en: Compare two or more sources cell by cell along fixed dimensions, listing agreed, disputed and missing items without deciding which is right

now.zh-CN: 把已确认结论整理为知识库条目草案，含适用范围、来源清单与最近核对日期；与旧条目冲突时并列差异
now.en: Draft knowledge base articles from confirmed findings with scope, source list and last-checked date; conflicts with existing articles shown side by side

now.zh-CN: 从文档与对话记录提取术语表，定义附来源，别名合并，冲突定义并列
now.en: Extract a glossary from documents and conversations; definitions sourced, aliases merged, conflicting definitions listed side by side

needs.zh-CN: 文档、报告、网页快照或对话记录等资料
needs.en: Documents, reports, web snapshots or conversation records

needs.zh-CN: 研究问题与读者；可选对比维度、来源优先级、知识库模板或已有条目
needs.en: The research question and audience; optionally comparison dimensions, source priority, knowledge base template or existing articles

needs.zh-CN: 如需检索公开网页或写入知识库，另行添加并授权 context7、deepwiki、exa、notion 或语雀连接器（均为可选）
needs.en: To search public pages or write to a knowledge base, add and authorize the context7, deepwiki, exa, notion or yuque connector separately (all optional)

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取你本次提供的文件；授权检索时只查与问题直接相关的公开内容并记录检索日期
permissions.en: Reads only the files you provide; with search authorized, looks up only public content related to the question and records the retrieval date

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：写入知识库或外部系统、发送或分享草案、引用个人信息或未公开信息、把某来源当作权威
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: writing to a knowledge base or external system, sending or sharing drafts, quoting personal or unpublished information, treating one source as authoritative

conditions.zh-CN: 2026-09-25 已用真实模型（DeepSeek deepseek-flash，隔离的测试环境）验证：研究简报、多源对比、知识库条目三个模板按合成样例产出结构与期望一致，关键事实逐条标注来源与位置，分歧并列不裁定，未写入知识库或外部系统。
conditions.en: Verified with a real model (DeepSeek deepseek-flash, isolated test environment) on 2026-09-25: research brief, source comparison and knowledge-base article matched the expected structure on synthetic samples; facts carry source and location, disagreements are listed without adjudication, nothing written to any knowledge base or external system.

conditions.zh-CN: 检索连接器与知识库写入连接为可选项，本版不内置。
conditions.en: Search connectors and knowledge base write connections are optional and not bundled in this version.
